summary: The 6-keyframe contact sheet perfectly matches all brand design system requirements and custom user rules. Keyframe 1 opens with the specified Cobalt/Lime color-block reality check card before transitioning into the #EAEAE6 graph-paper grid across Keyframes 2-6. Typography accurately pairs Italic Editorial Serif lead-ins with heavy Bold Sans punch words. Selection containers feature dashed borders with 4-corner anchor dots on list items ('Faster', 'Sharper', 'Effective') and rule cards. Visual metaphors (dashed circular 3D bullseye, brain puzzle piece, 4-bar audience telemetry chart with curved drop arrow, and mechanical keycap slam) are clearly rendered. Numeric stats consistently use glowing Amber (#FF9500) odometer cards with zero text clipping or overlapping.
